title: TypeScript Basics
intro: TypeScript is the default for any professional React or Angular codebase in 2024, and freshers who understand it have a clear edge. For Java developers, TypeScript feels intuitive because you already think in types — the mental leap is smaller than you expect. The key is understanding where TypeScript's type system differs from Java: structural typing instead of nominal, types erased at runtime, and union types as a first-class feature.
